# Policymaker #249, iteration 0034

Review #247 accepted the condition-aware development scorer at main 8a8455f and had no numbered findings ([report](.session/history/sessions/247/248e06dd31e0e16ec47e7e4a3bbc679cbd318638e2a47d0303abf6c9870f53d7.md)). Mutations a–d behaved as the protocol requires, and regenerating the results gave identical bytes (score.py 810a5457…, results a5b97984…). The scorer fix rounds are now closed. This was the fourth review done by the same model family as the author (codex gpt-6.1-sol, 325k input). I recorded that as a known limit and will stop retrying the `opus` alias for reviewers.

Changes:
- I wrote `execution/scripts/land_scorer_review_247.py`, an idempotent, git-free script. It first checks that both files still have the reviewed hashes. It then pins score.py and the results under the challenges milestone and sets that milestone to `scorer-reviewed`. It also replaces the old limitation sentence that said "no scorer" with an accurate one, which keeps the same-family limit and the fact that the #212 gap row was not re-reviewed. Finally it re-pins the references to preparation-status.json. I ran it on a temporary copy of main: running it twice changed nothing; every `--check` exited 0 (lineage, dev_cases and sources with LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT set); the evaluator showed missing [] and 51 references; only the two preparation JSON files changed.
- I updated `policy/working-memory.md` with what iteration 0034 found and what to do next.

Orders (run in parallel from main, wake false):
- `land-scorer-review-247` (benchmark, low, 20 min / 15 turns): one script run. Expected gain: the reviewed scorer becomes pinned evidence. Check: the challenges milestone on main reads `scorer-reviewed` and the evaluator shows 51 references.
- `typedef-impact-feasibility` (benchmark, medium, 45 min / 30 turns, report only): count the .ctl files and list up to 5 candidate typedefs with users found by static evidence, plus the reference kinds static reading cannot see. Expected gain: decide whether to build a typedef-impact development case or record it as a named gap. Check: counts and candidates in its report.

Not covered yet: no agent or reader run has been executed, there is no native evidence (#169 still waiting), the split has not started, there is no diagram-difference case, and no review has come from a different model family. The benchmark is not ready, and I have not asked the owner to accept the method.

## What next
- Confirm the landing on main, then delete the landing script.
- Decide on the typedef case from the report.
- Remaining work: a diagram-difference case (needs paired revisions), and a capability request for the split (restricted store/custodian).
- Show the owner the effort estimate in docs/research/0002-delivery.md before choosing the LabVIEW 2024 fallback. Do not order the research again.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
